extracted.intended_audience: news consumers, journalists, educators, and researchers who want to evaluate or compare media sources by bias and reliability
extracted.subtask_description: Use an interactive chart to locate, filter, and compare news/media sources along two evaluative dimensions (bias and reliability) and by media type. The tool supports searching by source name and restricting the view by format and numeric ranges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Type the source name
rubrics_metrics.description: Ability to identify and search for a specific media source by name ('Type the source name').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the search control to locate a particular outlet so you can view its placement on the chart; no additional scoring guidance is provided on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Type
rubrics_metrics.description: Filter sources by their format: 'Website / Articles', 'TV / Video', 'Podcast / Audio'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select one or more media type filters to restrict the displayed sources to a particular medium (useful for comparing similar formats).

rubrics_metrics.name: Filter source reliability range
rubrics_metrics.description: Numeric reliability dimension allowing users to set a range (page shows example range endpoints '0' and '64').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adjust the reliability slider to include only sources within a chosen reliability band; the page does not define the exact scale or scoring rubric but exposes a numeric filter for reliability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filter source bias range
rubrics_metrics.description: Numeric bias dimension allowing users to set a range (page shows example values '-42', '0', '42').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adjust the bias slider to include only sources within a chosen bias range (center indicated by '0'); the page provides these numeric endpoints as controls but does not include detailed normative definitions on the page itself.
